blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound hard. But in English, they follow simple patterns. Today we learn five useful words: receipt, proof, expense, deductible, and record.

Sophie opens a folder of expenses with the student. "The receipt must be correct before we send the form," she says. Every deductible is checked before the deadline. The record stays in the fiscal folder for seven years.

Sophie explains the tax words slowly, in simple English. Taxes are just one more part of the company's routine. One small step at a time — taxes become easier with practice.

items.why: "Today we learn five useful words."

items.q: What does Sophie open with the student?
items.why: "Sophie opens a folder of expenses with the student."

items.q: How long does the record stay in the fiscal folder?
items.why: "The record stays in the fiscal folder for seven years."

items.q: The text suggests that Sophie is…
items.why: Inferência: ela explica devagar, em inglês simples, "one small step at a time" — é paciente.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
items.why: Inferência: "taxes become easier with practice" e "they follow simple patterns".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie revisar a pasta de despesas com o aluno. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I'm Sophie. Let's look at this folder together. It's easy, I promise.

Here is the first receipt. Do we have proof for this expense? Yes, we have the receipt right here. Good. But wait — is this expense deductible? Hmm, no. This one is not deductible. We do not put it on the tax form.

Now, do you have the record for last month? No? That's okay. We look for it together. The record is important. It stays in the fiscal folder for seven years.

Let me ask you one thing. Do we have all the receipts for March? Let me check. One, two, three... yes, we have them all. Very good!

See? Taxes are not scary. One small step at a time. You do a little every week, and it becomes easy. I'm ready for the next tax topic. Are you?
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Does Sophie have proof for the first expense?
items.why: "Yes, we have the receipt right here."

items.q: Is the first expense deductible?
items.why: "No. This one is not deductible."

items.q: Does the student have the record for last month?
options: No, so they look for it together
items.why: "No? That's okay. We look for it together."

items.q: Sophie says taxes are "not scary." This suggests she wants the student to feel…
items.why: Inferência: ela repete que é fácil, "I promise", "one small step at a time" — quer tranquilizar.

items.q: The audio suggests that doing a little every week…
items.why: Inferência: "You do a little every week, and it becomes easy."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please keep the receipt from the store." A receipt is…
options: a paper that shows you paid
items.why: Receipt = recibo: o papel que mostra que você pagou.

items.q: "We need proof for every payment." Proof means…
options: something that shows it is true
items.why: Proof = comprovante: algo que mostra que é verdade.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The lunch with the client is a work ___."
items.why: Expense = despesa: um gasto do trabalho.

items.q: "This cost is deductible." This means you can…
items.why: Deductible = dedutível: pode ser abatido dos impostos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We keep a ___ of every payment for seven years."
items.why: Record = registro: guardamos o registro de cada pagamento.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com impostos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you fill out this tax form?" To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher: escrever as respostas no formulário.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "Please hold on to the receipt." This means…
items.why: Hold on to = guardar, manter com você.

items.q: "Let's go over the expenses together." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, checar com atenção.

items.q: "We must send the form on time." On time means…
items.why: On time = no prazo, sem atraso.
